name: Luvina Jupiter
source:
Luvina is a seer that was sold to princess [url=/c69555]Iris[/url] at a young age. Luvina takes the world for what it is, and doesn't have much creativity or imagination. While not a love interest, Luvina is very invested in helping [url=/c69553]Kira[/url] to understand that they are more alike than they want to believe.

[From [url=https://rooftopsrevolution.itch.io/paper-roses]itch.io[/url]]
